source_clause: NOPR0.) R1 High Only: this passage is not meant to be implemented. CPA will not be launched and it will be accessible from the Edit Profile screen only. Therefore, after choosing the avatar, the system will keep current preferences and will begin Tutorials (refer to Tutorials L&F)
leaf_desc_037: NOPR0.) R1 High Only: this passage is not meant to be implemented. CPA will not be launched and it will be accessible from the Edit Profile screen only. Therefore, after choosing the avatar, the system will keep current preferences and will begin Tutorials (refer to Tutorials L&F)
reasoning: 驗證目標：6.1（NOPR0）—— R1 High 上 CPA 不啟動；選完 avatar 後保留現有偏好並進入 Tutorials。關鍵情境條件：車型須為 R1 High —— 本條之全部內容皆以此為前提。為什麼這樣切：`design_method` 取情境／用例 ——本條驗的是**一段流程之走向**（avatar → 不進 CPA → 進 Tutorials），非單一畫面之功能點。**AB-1（45 包）之連帶**：ER4 之兩端**皆為現用 profile 之偏好**（設定前後兩個時點），故指名之 —— 與 `TC-154` 不同：那一條之兩端是**兩個不同的 profile**。**本條之兩端同物不是恆真**：其間之事件（avatar 步驟）在 base 變體上正是 CPA 會介入之處。**ER4 之偏好比對不可省**：條文說的是 `keep current preferences`，一個「跳過 CPA 但把偏好重設為預設」之實作，只驗 Tutorials 有沒有開會通過（§8.3）。

tcs.tc_title: R1 High keeps preferences and begins Tutorials after avatar
tcs.test_item: R1 High keeps preferences and begins Tutorials after avatar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is an R1 High variant
2. A New Profile Setup is in progress at the avatar step
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the current preferences of the active Driver Profile
2. Choose an avatar and press Save & Continue
3. Read the screen shown after the avatar step
4. Read the preferences of the active Driver Profile and compare them with step 1
tcs.expected_result:
1. The current preferences are recorded
2. The avatar is chosen and the avatar step ends
3. Tutorials begin and no Connected Personal Account login is launched
4. The preferences of the active Driver Profile are unchanged from those recorded in step 1
tcs.priority_basis: R1 High 之流程分歧本身 —— 誤啟 CPA 即為錯誤變體行為
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.remarks: **變體 axis `r1h-cpa-6.1`**：本條為 R1 High 側。base 側（`Is CPA present?` 為是時啟動 CPA 登入）**在 037 內無 leaf** —— 它只出現於 PDF p9 之流程圖，依 R-U56 不造 —— 其不造之判定已於變體覆寫之登記表逐條實測。條文尚有 `it will be accessible from the Edit Profile screen only` 一句 —— 該全稱之**反向**（他處不得進入 CPA）本條不涵蓋，其入口清單不可窮舉，已記為 ch11 之覆蓋事項（`SWE1-HMI-PROF-110` 為其正向）。
